verdict.rationale: llama.cpp documents a first-party CLI command, `llama serve -hf <model>`, that starts a local model server, and the server is shown backing the built-in web UI. Nothing in the evidence documents how to stop the server from the command line (e.g., a stop subcommand or graceful-shutdown behavior), so only the start half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented stop/shutdown command or behavior, hands-on corroboration of server lifecycle management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line

citations.quote: Built-in web UI against `llama serve` running Qwen 3.6
